label: Whatever is in act in some respect and in POTENCY_2 in some respect is composite
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever is in act in some respect and in potency in some respect is composite. InPotency is the free POTENCY_2 parameter and presupposes real passive potency; Composite is the inclusive SIMPLE_4 sense (without composition of any kind), so that STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE covers act-potency composition. The thought: a being whose actual being leaves a capacity unrealized has two principles, what it actually is and what it can be but is not. ST I q.3 a.7 co., fourth reason, states the converse (every composite has potency and act), not this direction. The restriction to beings in act in some respect keeps pure potency out: prime matter, in potency and in act in no respect, is not composite. This is where the dipolar rival presses: it grants the composition and denies that such a composite needs a cause. OPEN reading obligation (#1603): the warrant targets the bearer's own real passive potency, not receptive potency that can coexist with actual possession (RECEPTIVE_POTENCY_5 in DISAMB-POTENCY), not an ability or an active power, and not the mere logical possibility of being otherwise; the free parameter does not fix that reading.
